Pictured: Diane McPhee with her dog Boomer, after she was attacked by two dogs in the Tonna area on Neath, south Wales, UK.
Re: Diane McPhee was attacked by two rottweiler dogs which were at the time handled by Ailsa Lisanna Truman, while walking her own dog Boomer in a path in the Tonna area of Neath, south Wales. She was saved by farmer Richard Williams who was working on his property nearby. Subsequently, the case was dropped by a Crown Court judge as the police and the CPS failed to identify the exact dog that bit Mrs McPhee.
